shortDescription: Manages virtual machines in ESXi without a dependency on the vSphere/ vCenter API.

options.name: cdrom
options.description: A list of cdrom to add. A CD-ROM configuration for the virtual machine.

options.name: cloudinit_userdata
options.description: A list of userdata (per user) as defined U(https://cloudinit.readthedocs.io/en/latest/topics/examples.html).  The VM must already have cloud-init-vmware-guestinfo installed U(https://github.com/vmware/cloud-init-vmware-guestinfo)

options.name: customvalues
options.description: Define a list of custom values to set on virtual machine. A custom value object takes two fields C(key) and C(value). Incorrect key and values will be ignored.

options.name: datastore
options.description: Specify datastore or datastore cluster to provision virtual machine.

options.name: delete_cloudinit
options.description: Delete the cloud-init config after creation.  If you do this, you will need to remove cloud-init from the system, or it will overwrite with defaults on next boot.

options.name: disks
options.description: A list of disks to add (or create via cloning). Support resizing disks after added. Removing existing disks of the virtual machine is not supported.

options.name: force
options.description: Delete the existing host if it exists.  Use with extreme care!

options.name: guest_id
options.description: Set the guest ID. This parameter is case sensitive. {'Examples': None}   virtual machine with RHEL7 64 bit, will be 'rhel7-64'   virtual machine with CentOS 7 (64-bit), will be 'centos7-64'   virtual machine with Debian 9 (Stretch) 64 bit, will be 'debian9-64'   virtual machine with Ubuntu 64 bit, will be 'ubuntu-64'   virtual machine with Windows 10 (64 bit), will be 'windows9-64'   virtual machine with Other (64 bit), will be 'other-64' This field is required when creating a virtual machine, n

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the ESXi server.

options.name: moid
options.description: Managed Object ID of the virtual machine to manage This is required if C(name) is not supplied. If virtual machine does not exists, then this parameter is ignored. Will be ignored on virtual machine creation

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the virtual machine to work with. Virtual machine names in ESXi are unique This parameter is required, if C(state) is set to C(present) and virtual machine does not exists. This parameter is case sensitive.

options.name: networks
options.description: A list of networks (in the order of the NICs). Removing NICs is not allowed, while reconfiguring the virtual machine. All parameters and VMware object names are case sensetive. {'One of the below parameters is required per entry': None} [{'C(networkName) (string)': 'Name of the portgroup for this interface.'}] [{'C(virtualDev) (string)': 'Virtual network device (one of C(e1000e), C(vmxnet3) (default), C(sriov)).'}] {'Optional parameters per entry (used for OS customization)': None} [{'C(cloudini

options.name: password
options.description: The password of C(username) for the ESXi server, or the password for the private key (if required).

options.name: state
options.description: Specify the state the virtual machine should be in. If C(state) is set to C(present) and virtual machine exists, ensure the virtual machine configurations conforms to task arguments. If C(state) is set to C(absent) and virtual machine exists, then the specified virtual machine is removed with its associated components. options.name: template
options.description: Template or existing virtual machine used to create new virtual machine. If this value is not set, virtual machine is created without using a template. If the virtual machine already exists, this parameter will be ignored. This parameter is case sensitive.

options.name: username
options.description: The username to access the ESXi server at C(hostname).

options.name: wait
options.description: On creation, wait for the instance to obtain its IP address before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
